attempts_submitted_check.name: attempts_submitted_check
attempts_submitted_check.value: ("attempts"."status" = 'submitted') = ("attempts"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "attempts"."submit_reason" IS NOT NULL)

violations_penalty_check.name: violations_penalty_check
violations_penalty_check.value: ("violations"."penalty_type" = 'percent') = ("violations"."penalty_percent" IS NOT NULL) AND ("violations"."penalty_percent" IS NULL OR "violations"."penalty_percent" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

appeals_target_match.name: appeals_target_match
appeals_target_match.value: ("appeals"."target" = 'response' AND "appeals"."item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."violation_id" IS NULL) OR ("appeals"."target" = 'penalty' AND "appeals"."violation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."item_id" IS NULL)

appeals_response_len.name: appeals_response_len
appeals_response_len.value: "appeals"."response" IS NULL OR char_length("appeals"."response") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000

appeals_resolved_consistent.name: appeals_resolved_consistent
appeals_resolved_consistent.value: ("appeals"."status" = 'open' AND "appeals"."resolver_id" IS NULL AND "appeals"."response" IS NULL AND "appeals"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "appeals"."previous_value" IS NULL AND "appeals"."new_value" IS NULL) OR ("appeals"."status" = 'resolved' AND "appeals"."resolver_id" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."response" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."previous_value" IS NOT NULL AND "appeals"."new_value" IS NOT NULL)

session_gradings_finalize_idx.name: session_gradings_finalize_idx
session_gradings_finalize_idx.where: "session_gradings"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "session_gradings"."finalized_at" IS NULL

session_gradings_appeal_hours.name: session_gradings_appeal_hours
session_gradings_appeal_hours.value: "session_gradings"."appeal_period_hours" IS NULL OR "session_gradings"."appeal_period_hours" = 0 OR "session_gradings"."appeal_period_hours" BETWEEN 24 AND 336

session_gradings_release_consistent.name: session_gradings_release_consistent
session_gradings_release_consistent.value: ("session_gradings"."released_at" IS NULL) = ("session_gradings"."appeal_period_hours" IS NULL) AND ("session_gradings"."finalized_at" IS NULL OR "session_gradings"."released_at" IS NOT NULL)

users_code_active_key.name: users_code_active_key
users_code_active_key.where: "users"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "users"."code" IS NOT NULL

users_username_or_email.name: users_username_or_email
users_username_or_email.value: "users"."username" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."email" IS NOT NULL
